title: Deep learning radiomics classifies osteoporotic vertebral fractures on X-ray
summary: The study covered 942 patients (1,076 vertebrae) at three hospitals, with fractures classed 0, 1 or 2 by the Assessment System of Thoracolumbar Osteoporotic Fracture. Data were split into training (712), internal validation (178), external validation (111) and prospective validation (75) sets. ResNet-50 deep transfer learning (pre-trained on RadImageNet and ImageNet) was fused with radiomics features by LASSO, and eight machine learning models were evaluated one-vs-rest. Performance numbers were not visible in the reviewed abstract excerpt.
